title: Collect the Pictures Before You Interpret Them
description: On 8 February 2026 visual material gets a collector. Images become evidence with identity, not leftover files around the documents.
body:
A knowledge architecture that treats pictures as leftover files has already decided they do not count as work. The prompt is in the PNG. The frame is in a cache. The title is whatever the generator named it. None of that is a record you can stand on later.

On 8 February 2026 I add a collector and organizer for images from SwarmUI. Scan. Collect. Deduplicate by SHA-256. Keep a catalog of prompt, model, seed, and size. Dry-run and statistics so the operation can be inspected before it copies anything. This is not a claim that images are understood. It is a decision to stop treating them as unstructured residue around the documents.

The wrong default

The usual move is to jump to search. Embed first. Caption first. Ask the model what the picture means. That is interpretation without a place to put the original. If two files are the same picture under two names, a later caption will double the lie. Identity has to come first, the same way the November index left source files where they were and built a layer around them.

A specimen drawer is not a theory of biology. It is how you keep the moth from being lost in the coat pocket. Visual evidence needs that drawer: a repeatable intake, a hash, a catalog row, a source path. Description can wait until the thing has a place.

What the collector does

The script walks defined roots, classifies into folders, and writes metadata the generator already embedded. It is a local hygiene tool, not the MCP server and not the petroleum overlay. It does not yet put images into pgvector. It does not yet know episode or scene. Those come later this month. On this date the result is more basic: visual material has an intake, and the intake can be run without moving ownership of the originals in any grand sense — it copies into an organized tree with a catalog beside it.

A photograph, a production still, a diagram, or a generated frame can hold evidence a filename will not. If it remains isolated, it cannot take part in the wider memory of the work. Collection is the starting point for a larger question: how visual material can be described faithfully, given a vocabulary, and retrieved alongside documents. That question is not answered today.

The collector can search its own catalog and print statistics. That is enough to ask whether a prompt, a model, or a seed already exists before you generate it again. It is not VALESKA search. It is not an assistant tool. It is the unglamorous intake without which later captioning would be theater on top of duplicates.

The next test

The next work is more sources, a place in the narrative of the work, and a test of whether the collection can be found by meaning rather than by folder. For now the important result is the unglamorous one: pictures have a door into the evidence base, and the door can be opened the same way twice.

Historical basis: VALESKA commit e408f06, February 8, 2026; contemporaneous scripts/swarmui_image_collector.py. Later February narrative fields and pgvector ingest are not treated as known on this date.
